system.flavor:
Walk three people across a warded threshold, through a cursed fog, or past a glowing rune without harm. Shrug off a hex long enough to finish a task.

Not enough to break a ward, lift a curse, or cross a sealed gate.

body.label: Target
body.html: Self and up to two willing allies within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Each target reduces its next incoming magical Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn; suppress one ordinary magical Success Die penalty on each for the same duration.

surges.html: Also resist each target's next 1 unit of magical forced movement until the start of your next turn.
One target reduces that incoming Damage by 1 more.

rider.title: Aether Thread
rider.html: Gain an Aether Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: increase its Success Die by 1, to a maximum of 10. This does not generate Surges.
